items.markdown:
Thailand offers several main visa categories based on the purpose and length of stay, including `Tourist Visas, Non-Immigrant Visas, and Long-Term Resident options`.[](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/top-8-thai-visa-categories-travel-work-study-retirement-and-more.html) [[1]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/top-8-thai-visa-categories-travel-work-study-retirement-and-more.html)

Tourist & Short-Term Visas

- **Visa Exemption / Tourist Stamp:** Allows eligible nationals a 60-day stay upon arrival, extendable for 30 days.
- **Tourist Visa (TR):** Pre-arranged single or multiple-entry visa for leisure travel, granting initial 60-day stays.
- **Destination Thailand Visa (DTV):** Designed for digital nomads and wellness travelers, allowing stays up to 180 days per entry over a 5-year period.
- **Transit / Visa on Arrival:** Short 15 to 30-day stays for connecting travel or brief entry.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types)[[2]](https://th.usembassy.gov/thai-visas-for-americans/)[[3]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)[[4]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thai-visa)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNBGzHDXfVg&t=275)[[6]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/publicservice/84395-types-of-visas?page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072dd&menu=5f4b6eb3f6ae4b236972c562)

Non-Immigrant Visas (Medium to Long-Term)

- **Non-Immigrant B (Business/Work):** For individuals working, teaching, or conducting business, sponsored by a local company.
- **Non-Immigrant ED (Education):** For students enrolled in approved schools or universities.
- **Non-Immigrant O (Family/Retirement):** For retirees aged 50 and over or those married to/dependent on Thai nationals or legal residents.[](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/top-8-thai-visa-categories-travel-work-study-retirement-and-more.html) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y1eqbgS0mxo&t=125)

Special Long-Term Programs

- **Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa:** A 10-year visa targeting wealthy global citizens, remote workers, and skilled professionals.
- **Thailand Privilege Visa (Elite):** A paid membership program granting multi-year stays ranging from 5 to 20 years with VIP airport perks.[](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/top-8-thai-visa-categories-travel-work-study-retirement-and-more.html) [[1]](https://www.siam-legal.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa.php)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_56xA5oPz4c)
